summary: GonkaRouter is an AI model router on the Gonka network, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs and paid pricing from $0.0061 per 1M tokens. New accounts automatically receive 1M free tokens, which are used before any paid balance. No credit card is required and there is no subscription. Sign-in is by email or Google.
claim_steps: Sign in to GonkaRouter with email or Google
Point your OpenAI SDK at the GonkaRouter API; the 1M free tokens are used before any paid balance
